messages:
sam: getting alerts: GPU attach backlog in eu-west3, looks correlated with janitor scrubs.
anya: how many nodes?
sam: ~7 nodes, attach pending ~1200. quick log from gn-ew3-09:
```
2026-04-02T01:14:05Z janitor[pid=810]: scrub start range=0x4f00-0x4fff
2026-04-02T01:14:06Z compactor[pid=811]: rewrite-index id=0x4f7d tmp=idx.4f7d.tmp
2026-04-02T01:14:07Z attach-controller[pid=2200]: validate-local-index id=0x4f7d err=NOREF
```
kevin: NOREF -> index rewrite raced with attach validate. Looks like concurrent scrub/attach window.
anya: mitigation?
sam: ops-bot, can we route new attaches away from eu-west3 for 15m?
ops-bot: Applying route override: prefer-region global weight eu-west3=0 -> success (propagating).
kevin: I'll push attach-retry patch (retry after refreshing index once) as a quick fix and schedule compactor throttle.
anya: cost note: cross-region fallback will incur egress on heavy batches, flagging finance.
sam: pending queue dropped to 350 after routing + canary. Follow-up: add metric scrub_index_rewrites and alert on >3/min.
